mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.user_id AS userId, r.parent_id AS parentId, r.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, r.content, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime, p.title AS postTitle, u.username AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, u.phone AS userPhone, ru.username AS replyToUserName, pr.content AS parentContent FROM post_reply r LEFT JOIN forum_post p ON r.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_info ru ON r.reply_to_user_id = ru.id LEFT JOIN post_reply pr ON r.parent_id = pr.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM post_reply WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE post_reply SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.user_id AS userId, r.parent_id AS parentId, r.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, r.content, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, ru.username AS replyToUserName FROM post_reply r LEFT JOIN user_info u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_info ru ON r.reply_to_user_id = ru.id WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.user_id AS userId, r.parent_id AS parentId, r.reply_to_user_id AS replyToUserId, r.content, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, ru.username AS replyToUserName FROM post_reply r LEFT JOIN user_info u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_info ru ON r.reply_to_user_id = ru.id WHERE r.parent_id = #{parentId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalReplyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayReplyCount FROM post_reply WHERE is_deleted = 0
